The trace is the work. Each attestation now ships the verification log behind it: signature check, nonce arithmetic, balance delta, ancestry path, with timings. The node replays one trace in twenty and compares hashes at six checkpoints. Fifty clones built from one script emit identical scaffolding across different transactions, so their attestations merge into one weight. Fifty separate implementations cost around 300 developer hours at $40, $12,000, and each needs maintenance.

A sonnet written at dawn beside one river sounds like itself; fifty photocopies share one watermark.
